title: VimPrescriptiveProvision
description: One provision of the VIM prescriptive layer — a statement of a definition file that prescribes something, with its place in the file, its verification and its audit trail

provision_id.description: Stable identifier, unique in the layer. Opaque for consumers; the recommended form is p-<clause>-<n>, or p-page<page>-<n> without a clause

kind.description: Kind of the provision, following its verbal form: requirement (shall, must), recommendation (should), permission (may, need not)

clause.description: Number or label of the clause that holds the provision

text.description: Verbatim text of the provision. May be left out when the licence of the definition file does not allow a verbatim copy; at least one of text and statement is present

statement.description: The provision in the words of the producer; at least one of text and statement is present

text_hash.description: First 16 hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 hash of the verbatim text, trimmed and with every run of white space replaced by one space. Computed even when text is left out

anchors.description: Places of the provision in the definition file, at least one

references.description: reference_id values of the layer that the provision uses

terms.description: term_id values of the layer that the provision uses

relations.description: Links to other provisions of the layer

verification.description: How the provision can be checked

status.description: Quality mark of the item, not the state of a review process: proposed (no person has checked the output of the producer), confirmed, rejected

provenance.description: Provenance of this provision; overrides the provenance of the layer

revisions.description: Audit trail of changes (ordered by revision number); the property field of a revision names the changed property

Anchor.description: A place in the definition file. page and bbox are the durable anchor; element_id is valid only together with the physical layer of the same document

element_id.description: Identifier of the element in the physical layer of the same document

Relation.description: A link from this provision to another provision of the layer

Verification.description: How a provision can be checked

method.description: automatic (a rule can be evaluated on data without a person), test (the behaviour of the subject must be tested), manual (a person must judge it)

subject.description: What is checked (e.g. drawing, software, document)

rule.description: Machine-readable rule (open object). No rule language is defined; the content is an agreement between the producer and the checking tool
